.²2 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) To be made the subject of an assertion (in a sentence),
 opposed to {#viDeya#} which affirms or denies something about the subject.
 In a sentence the {#anuvAdya#} or subject which is supposed to be already
 known is repeated to mark its connection with the {#viDeya#} or predicate
 and should be placed first; {#anuvAdyamanuktvEva na viDeyamudIrayet#};
 in {#vfdDirAdEc#}, <ls>P. I. 1. 1</ls> {#AdEc#} should have been placed first,
 though the construction is defended by Patañjali.
